title: Rion-Wu-tech/wechat-intelligence-hub
why_read: A local-first tool for mining and organizing WeChat chat history into briefings and opportunity tracking, technically interesting but raises notable privacy considerations.
analysis: This project builds a local system that indexes and searches WeChat chat history, generating daily briefings, follow-up reminders, and opportunity tracking via a command-line interface. Technically, it involves data extraction from a closed messaging platform, local search indexing, and some LLM-based summarization pipeline ('Codex skills'). The scale of forks relative to stars is unusual and could reflect bot activity or a template-heavy community, which is worth noting. Privacy implications of building surveillance-style tooling over personal chat data deserve consideration even though the tool is framed as local-first and read-only.
